title: budget.v1
description: A file `budgets/<name>.yaml`: the impact one incident window may cause. It never says how an incident is made. Every class or key it does not name allows 0. `dialog_request_failed`, `call_cut`, `call_stranded`, `protocol_anomaly` and `unattributed` take no budget. ADR-0049.

name.description: Equal to the file stem; unique on the search path.

setup_failed.description: Allowances for failed setups, each keyed by stream, final code and reason. A failed setup matching no entry is a finding.

stream.description: A stream name, or `*` for each stream separately.

code.description: The final's status code; 0 is a setup with no final (`no_final`). Never a wildcard.

max_seconds.description: The allowance in seconds of the stream's offered rate: the count may reach max_seconds × the stream's cps.

setup_slow.description: Slow setups allowed in the window. `threshold_ms` replaces the profile's `setup_slow_ms` inside the window.

recovery.description: How long after `healed` traffic may take to come back to its baseline. Absent, it must be back before the window closes.

tolerance.description: The relative distance from the baseline that counts as back.

baseline_s.description: The length of the baseline, ending at `inject`.

hold_s.description: How long traffic must stay within tolerance to count as back.

classes.description: Allowances for impact classes a product added on the search path (`classes/`), by class name.
